<thought>Based on the observed isotopic pattern, the only element with a characteristic M+2 peak intensity (~4 % of the base peak) matching a known natural abundance is sulfur (34S ≈ 4 % of 32S). No chlorine (≈33 % M+2) or bromine (≈100 % M+2) patterns are present. Therefore, sulfur can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['S']</final_answer>
